prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: rear-end collision. Injury: concussion. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1403; do not mention it.)
text:
We have been retained by [CLIENT_NAME] in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE], in which your insured's vehicle struck the rear of our client's vehicle while it was stopped in traffic. The impact was forceful and the police report documents the rear-end nature of the collision, which places responsibility squarely on your insured.

As a direct result of the collision, our client sustained a concussion. Since the accident, our client has experienced persistent headaches, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. Treatment has included emergency evaluation, follow-up visits with a neurologist, and a period of restricted activity recommended by the treating physicians. Our client has also missed significant time from work and continues to experience symptoms that limit daily activities.

Medical bills, lost wages, and the pain and suffering associated with this injury are documented in the enclosed records. Based on these damages, our client is prepared to resolve this matter without litigation for the sum of [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice and seek all damages available under law.

Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to my office.
